_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (3% of 12h windows ±2 pts) plus failed bottom-rhyme factors make HOLD the graded call until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Denial; narrative silent on phase/direction (metals/oil tape only), so no forward-call agreement
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays inside ~1.5% range and score holds Denial band (32-38) through next session
next_move.invalidated_if: A >2.3% down day with funding negative and fear_greed under 20 drops score into Panic, or ETF flows turn up and squeeze score into Anxiety
